 By Data Skrive Nov. 12, 2026 1:45 pm EST Updated Share article 
 The Utah Mammoth (10-8-1) host the St. Louis Blues (8-8-2) at Delta Center on Nov. 12, 2026, starting at 9 p.m. ET on ESPN+. The Mammoth are eighth (with 21 points) and the Blues 11th (18 points) in the Western Conference.
 How to watch St. Louis Blues vs. Utah Mammoth
 Venue: Delta Center
 Time: 9 p.m. ET
 Streaming: ESPN+ (Sign in on ESPN+ with your Fubo account) 
 Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. 
 St. Louis vs. Utah odds
 Puck Line: Utah -1.5 (+203), St. Louis +1.5 (-253)
 Favorite Moneyline: Utah -115
 Underdog Moneyline: St. Louis -106
 Total: 5.5
 Total Over Odds: -138
 Total Under Odds: +115
 Injury reports
 Mammoth
 John Marino: Out (Upper Body), 
 Maveric Lamoureux: Out (Shoulder), 
 Nate Schmidt: Out (Upper Body), 
 Logan Cooley: Day-To-Day (Upper Body), 
 Dylan Guenther: Out (Undisclosed)
 Advertisement
 Blues

 Stats to know
 Over 19 games played, Clayton Keller has recorded 25 points (five goals and 20 assists).
 Karel Vejmelka has allowed 40 goals (3.29 goals-against average) and recorded 262 saves.
 Robert Thomas has recorded14 points this season (0.8 per game), with three goals and 11 assists in 18 games (playing 20:27 per game).
 Joel Hofer has a .920 save percentage (fifth-best in the league). He has 345 saves, and has given up 30 goals (2.3 goals-against average).
